description: compacts every folder of every account and reports the disk space recovered

functions.name: get_state
functions.description: returns the current phase, scan totals, progress and the result of the last run

functions.name: scan
functions.description: collects all compactable folders with their size on disk and the bytes Thunderbird expects to recover

functions.name: start
functions.description: rescans and starts compacting every folder, resolves as soon as the run has started

functions.name: stop
functions.description: lets the folders being compacted finish and starts no new ones

events.name: on_update
events.description: fired whenever the phase or the progress changes
